full_judgment: 7. The respondents contested, the said Administrative Tribunal Case by filing written statements denying all the material allegations made in the application. Their case is that the application is barred by limitation and not maintainable. The charge was duly framed against the petitioner on the allegations of negligence of duty and misconduct. On enquiry, the allegations were proved and the authority, considering the enquiry report and other papers on record imposed the penalty upon the petitioner dismissing high from service along with recovery of Taka 1,15,000 and the appeal and revision petition against the dismissal order was duly considered and rejected. No illegality or irregularity has been committed in the proceeding. The petitioner instituted this case on false allegations which is liable to be dismissed.
